newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-JAPAN'S HIRAKI BOWS OUT OF OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-JAPAN'S HIRAKI BOWS OUT OF OPEN.

text.p: Japan's Rika Hiraki bowed out of the Australian Open on Friday when she lost in straight sets to American Kimberly Po in the third round.
Hiraki, who caused one of the biggest upsets of the second round when she outed 10th seed Brenda Schultz-McCarthy of the Netherlands, fell 6-2 6-2.
In a match lasting exactly an hour, the tiny Japanese player, who is world ranked 86, failed to come to grips with the blustery conditions on an outside court in Melbourne.

The 25-year-old, who was born in Beirut but brought up in Japan, was the second Asian player to fall on Friday following Thai player Tamarine Tanasugarn's 6-1 6-0 loss to U.S. seventh seed Lindsay Davenport.
Only one Asian player remains in the women's draw -- Wang Shi-ting of Taiwan. Wang will play ninth seed Karina Habsudova of Slovakia in a third round match on Saturday.
